verdict.rationale: The evidence pack mentions choice of desktop environments and historical DE shifts (Unity, GNOME, Compiz) but provides no documentation of built-in theme switching for instantly restyling the whole desktop; community items discuss past DE transitions and complaints, not a theming feature. Missing for 10: any first-party docs on built-in theme presets (e.g. light/dark/accent variants), instructions for switching themes, or hands-on confirmation of instant whole-desktop restyling.
